title: Junk.
text: Junk.. Sadly, these worked for about six hours, then stopped. Switched out the batteries just in case, still nothing. Sad because they were cute. Would like to exchange for a new set, but since I'm high risk it's not worth me bringing them to the post office to send back. Disappointing.

product_metadata.title: Omika Flower String Lights Battery Operated, 16 Colors 40 LED 13ft Cherry Blossom Lights, 132 Modes USB Decorative Lights with Remote Control Gift for Teen Girls Kids Wedding Garden Decor
features: Perfect Holiday Decorative Lights: The decorative lights with charming cherry blossom will beautify your tree, fence, front path, or porch, creating a spring or wedding sweet atmosphere. Also, the Cherry blossom is IP65 Waterproof, which can withstand all kinds of weather, including heavy rain and snow. You can use these flower string lights as a garland for indoor or outdoor decor in the daytime and turn them on at night to add a charming and romantic atmosphere.

16 Colors Changing & 132 Lighting Modes: The cherry blossom lights have 16 solid colors. Each of 16 solid colors has 8 lighting modes (Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slow Glow, Chasing, Slow Fade, Twinkle, Breathing). It also has another 4 dynamic multicolor modes (fade, jump, flash, chase). Give you a unique lighting experience.

Multifunctional Remote Control: We offer the remote control for the color changing string lights, so you can lay on the bed to control the battery operated lights. The flower string lights have the dimmable and timer function, it can adjust the brightness levels and set the time according to your need. Also, the remote should point at the receiver within a distance of 33ft.

Battery powered & USB powered: The cherry blossom string lights is powered by 3 AA batteries (not included), no heat energy consumption, and no pollution. Also, the Valentine lights include a USB cable that enables you to plug the string lights into the USB hub, power adapter, laptop, TV, or power bank. You can use the string lights almost anywhere.

Wide applications: The flowers are soft design and pretty sturdy, you can bend any shape for your decorating needs, Also, the flowers can be cuttable, you can separate the petals according to different occasions, it's suitable for Valentine's Day,Mother's Day wedding, birthday party and more, light up your garden and add joyful atmosphere to your holiday. You can use cherry blossom decor on your Thanksgiving Halloween Christmas day.
